# opstracer_log_alert_rule (Resource)

A rule on an `opstracer_log_alert_monitor`: raises an alert when the number of matching log lines within `window_minutes` crosses `threshold`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "opstracer_log_alert_rule" "api_errors" {
  monitor_id     = opstracer_log_alert_monitor.api.id
  name           = "API error burst"
  match_level    = "error"
  threshold      = 10
  window_minutes = 5
  severity       = "P2"
}

resource "opstracer_log_alert_rule" "api_oom" {
  monitor_id     = opstracer_log_alert_monitor.api.id
  name           = "API out of memory"
  match_text     = ["OutOfMemoryError", "OOMKilled"]
  threshold      = 0
  window_minutes = 1
  severity       = "P1"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `monitor_id` (String) Monitor whose logs the rule evaluates.
- `name` (String) Rule name, used as the alert title.
- `severity` (String) Severity of the raised alert, P1 ... P5.
- `threshold` (Number) Number of matching log lines in the window that raises the alert.
- `window_minutes` (Number) Length of the counting window, 1 to 60 minutes.

### Optional

- `enabled` (Boolean) Set to false to keep the rule without evaluating it.
- `match_level` (String) Only count log lines of this level: `error` or `warn`.
- `match_text` (List of String) Only count log lines that contain any of these strings.
- `service_id` (String) Only count log lines of this service of the source.
- `service_name` (String) Display name of `service_id`.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Rule ID.
- `state` (String) Current evaluation state reported by the server.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import opstracer_log_alert_rule.api_errors <rule-id>
```
